title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs bug fix and enhancement update
description: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-118028) exists in Apache Tomcat's RedirectValve component, where execution continues after a redirect response, allowing remote attackers to bypass access controls. This affects Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs including various tomcat10 packages. The vulnerability is exploitable only if the RewriteValve is enabled and configured with redirect or forbidden rules. Systems with default Tomcat configurations are not affected. Red Hat has released updated RPMs to address this issue.
